observation: Fresh main enforces the browser-check count budget but normalizeBrowserChecks still silently filtered malformed entries. A requested browser validation set containing both valid and malformed entries could therefore lose a target and still pass on the remaining checks.
changes: Require browserChecks to be an array and every supplied entry to be a non-null, non-array object instead of silently filtering malformed entries.
Return a structured BROWSER_CHECK_INPUT_INVALID receipt before command or browser execution when the supplied check set is malformed.
Keep well-shaped check arrays and the existing eight-check budget behavior unchanged.
